label: Envelope (subject and preheader)
description: The email's envelope copy — what appears in the inbox rather than in the message. ADR-162 point 1: subject and preheader are fields of an email, so they live in the composition like every other field, not as columns on the variant. Named `header` until 2026-10-10 (task-349, ADR-193 point 6); frames frozen before then still say `header`.
